A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the use of clay as a filler in chitosan matrix is very promising in the field of adsorption of cationic dyes.
the magnetic chitosan/clays beads are a good alternative to remove cationic dyes from water in large pH range and in a fast way.
the magnetic beads are efficient magsorbents for the removal of dye from water.
The main takeaway from our work is that

the adsorption of MB by chitosan/clays beads is mainly driven by electrostatic interaction between MB and the clay surface and that this interaction is favored by the presence of a large amount of clay in the chitosan beads.
magnetic beads with clay can be considered as promising adsorbent for the treatment of cationic dyes from water.
the magnetic composite beads can be easily removed by a magnet after the adsorption of the dye and can be used for the removal of other pollutants from water.
